title.zh: Opus 5.5，把代码拍成电影

description.zh: 这不是把一句提示词交给视频模型，而是让 Opus 写动画、浏览器画帧、剪辑工具合成。它真正改变的，是影片可以怎样修改。
description.en: Opus writes animation, a browser renders frames, and editing tools assemble the film. The interesting change is how precisely a film can be revised.

title.zh: 集邮册动效：把一个动作做完整
title.en: Stamp-book motion: finish one small gesture

description.zh: 翻页、落章、再翻页。这个案例的价值在动作之间的节奏与材质衔接，适合当作 UI 和品牌动效的观察样本，不必套一个宏大的 AI 结论。
description.en: Page turn, stamp, next page. Study the rhythm and material transitions as UI or brand-motion inspiration; the example does not need a grand AI thesis.

title.zh: 15 秒艺术史：看表达，也看压缩的代价
title.en: Art history in 15 seconds: expression and compression

description.zh: 作者展示 Fable 5.5 的艺术史动画，适合观察视觉过渡和风格连贯性。把四万年压进十几秒，是创意概括；历史准确性、制作耗时与可复现程度不能仅从成片推断。
description.en: The creator’s Fable 5.5 clip offers visual transitions and stylistic continuity to study. Condensing history is a creative interpretation; a clip alone cannot establish historical accuracy, production time or reproducibility.

title.zh: 技术变快，创意的判断仍要留下
title.en: Faster technology still needs creative judgment

description.zh: Katzenberg 的观点把讨论拉回想象力、情感和创作者报酬。和封面专题一起看，值得问的是：当出片更容易，故事、选择与合作条款能不能同步变好？
description.en: Katzenberg brings the discussion back to imagination, emotion and compensation for creators. Alongside the cover story, ask whether easier production also improves storytelling, choices and collaboration terms.

title.zh: 上下文瘦了，证据不能丢

description.zh: Pi 把档案与工作台分开，SoL-Pi 再压缩重复信息。但一张更便宜的账单，可能也对应更少的成功任务。
description.en: Pi separates the archive from the working context; SoL-Pi reduces repetition. A smaller bill can also come with fewer solved tasks.

title.zh: Pi Agent 1.0：极简助手，长任务新路
title.en: Pi Agent 1.0: two paths for agent work

description.zh: Pi 1.0 延续终端里的极简交互，实验性的 Pi Durable 探索长任务恢复。沿着这次发布，看 Agent 怎样兼顾轻与稳。
description.en: Pi 1.0 refines the minimal terminal agent; the experimental Pi Durable explores long-running work. The release brings both choices into focus.

title.zh: Claude Mods，让工作台长出自己的工具
title.en: Claude Mods: tools that fit your workflow

description.zh: 从观察上下文到插入提醒，终端里的 Agent 正在变成可以定制的工作环境。
description.en: From context displays to timely reminders, the terminal agent is becoming a customizable work environment.

title.zh: 从写代码，走到负责运行
title.en: From writing code to operating systems

description.zh: 腾讯云 SRE 实践把基础设施、可观测数据和知识建成关联图谱，并把能力分成只读诊断、授权建议与自动执行。值得借鉴的是渐进放权：先证明能解释故障，再让它参与改变系统。
description.en: The Tencent Cloud SRE case connects infrastructure, observations and knowledge in a graph, and stages capability from read-only diagnosis to approved recommendations and execution. The lesson is gradual delegation: demonstrate explanations before permitting operational changes.

title.zh: 先定义分工，再组 Agent 团队
title.en: Define the work before assembling an agent team

description.zh: 这条 Opus 团队案例可以作为搭建入口。真正需要先决定的是角色边界、交接产物与验收条件；任务能够独立验证，团队协作才不会只增加对话。
description.en: The Opus team example is a starting point. Decide role boundaries, handoff artifacts and acceptance checks first; independently verifiable work keeps collaboration from merely adding conversation.

title.zh: Jev 怎么分工，才是真的省？
title.en: When does Jev routing actually save money?

description.zh: Jev 的五条收藏都在讨论分工：分类、打分与选择，是否每次都需要完整的生成式推理？
description.en: Five Jev saves explore division of labor: do classification, scoring and routing always require full generative reasoning?

title.zh: 90.5% 与约五分之一成本：评测怎样把钱省对
title.en: 90.5% at about a fifth of the cost: an eval case

description.zh: 一个 44 条支持工单的案例，展示了为什么“分数更高”必须说清在哪组样本上，以及 Agent 到底改了什么。
description.en: A 44-ticket support case shows why a higher score needs a named dataset—and an account of what the agent changed.

title.zh: 关键节点叫一次顾问
title.en: Bring in an advisor at decision points

description.zh: 主模型负责执行，顾问在计划前、反复失败时或完成前检查盲点。这是社区提供的使用思路；配置名称和模型可用性应以当前工具文档为准，不必让每一步都经过双模型。
description.en: Use the main model for execution and an advisor before a plan, after repeated failures or before completion. This is a community workflow idea; confirm current configuration and model availability rather than using two models for every step.

title.zh: ElevenLabs

description.zh: 把旁白、配音与对话式语音能力集中在一个云端平台。
description.en: A hosted platform for narration, dubbing and conversational voice.

title.zh: VoiceStudio

description.zh: 社区推荐的本地语音工具，覆盖克隆、合成与配音。
description.en: A community-recommended local tool for cloning, synthesis and dubbing.

title.zh: drawgent

description.zh: 把编码 Agent 接到 Excalidraw，可读取并修改同一张图。
description.en: Connect coding agents to a shared Excalidraw canvas.

title.zh: Chit

description.zh: 把本地 Claude Code 工作历史整理成按项目分组的小票。
description.en: Turn local Claude Code history into project-based receipts.

title.zh: Hemory

description.zh: 把日常语音转成可检索的记忆，再提供给 Agent 使用。
description.en: Convert everyday speech into searchable memory for agents.

title.zh: NOAN

description.zh: 给业务 Agent 准备统一的事实与上下文。
description.en: A shared source of business facts and context for agents.

title.zh: Rene

description.zh: 把个人助理延伸到移动端与多人协作场景。
description.en: A personal assistant spanning mobile and shared workflows.

title.zh: Invent a Dataset

description.zh: 从任务意图出发生成特定用途的训练数据。
description.en: Generate task-specific training data from an intent.

title.zh: Maestro

description.zh: 用可读流程描述移动端与 Web 的界面测试。
description.en: Describe mobile and web UI tests with readable flows.

title.zh: e2e · TesterArmy

description.zh: 将确定性定位与 AI 操作步骤放在同一套测试里。
description.en: Combine deterministic locators and AI steps in one test.

title.zh: Sonnet 5.5：日常任务的效率竞争

description.zh: 官方发布强调速度与效率的提升。这条收藏更值得关注的是任务分层：日常修复、文档与边界清楚的工作，可以重新比较不同模型的成本和结果；不要把某项基准持平等同于所有工作都能替代。
description.en: The official launch emphasizes speed and efficiency. Revisit model choice for bounded tasks such as fixes and documents; similar benchmark scores do not mean interchangeable performance on every workload.

title.zh: DevDay 与 Jev：决策能力开始成为平台接口
title.en: DevDay and Jev: decisions as a platform capability

description.zh: 两篇收藏分别总结 DevDay 和讨论 Decisions API 对 Jev 的竞争。它们指向决策层平台化，但“杀死竞品”仍是原作者的判断。评估时应比较可用范围、结构化输出、延迟、成本与迁移代价，而不是只比较发布声量。
description.en: The two saves summarize DevDay and debate the Decisions API’s impact on Jev. They point toward decisions becoming a platform capability; “killing” a competitor is the author’s interpretation. Compare availability, output guarantees, latency, cost and switching overhead.

title.zh: DEX #365：动效普及后，什么还稀缺？
title.en: DEX #365: what remains scarce when motion is easy?

description.zh: 这份邮件周刊把动效普及与 Personal Agent 放在一起观察：制作门槛下降，并不自动产生好作品；个人 Agent 也需要资源与交互体验支撑。它为封面补了一层判断。阅读流保留了邮件全文，原邮件没有公开 URL。
description.en: This email issue connects ubiquitous motion design with personal agents: lower production barriers do not automatically produce good work, and assistants still need resources and good interactions. It adds an editorial counterpoint to the cover. The saved email has no public original URL.

title.zh: AIGC #190：一份生态观察

description.zh: 阅读流里保存的可见部分讨论 Opus、Muse 与创作案例。本期只据这部分做索引，不把未保存的付费内容当作已读来源。它与 DEX 形成对照：一个聚焦上新与案例，一个追问体验与作品质量。
description.en: The accessible saved portion discusses Opus, Muse and creative examples. This issue indexes only that portion and does not treat the uncaptured paid remainder as read. Alongside DEX, it contrasts new releases with questions about experience and quality.

title.zh: 私人助理，究竟替用户省什么？
title.en: What does a personal assistant actually save?

description.zh: “没人真想要 AI 私人助理”是一条鲜明的观点，不是需求统计。它提出的提醒很有用：用户想少操心，未必想交出决定权。产品应该先找到具体的重复任务，并把建议、授权和执行分开，而不是先许诺接管人生。
description.en: “Nobody wants an AI assistant” is a provocative opinion, not demand data. The useful question is whether users want less mental effort without surrendering decisions. Start with specific repeated tasks and separate recommendations, approvals and execution.

title.zh: 创作之后，还要考虑作品怎么被找到

description.zh: 这条小红书获客经验是本期的边界素材：它不直接讲 AI，却提醒内容生产还有分发与转化。保留为短读，不上升为平台规律；发布时间、账号策略和流量结论都是作者的经验，不能保证复现。
description.en: This Xiaohongshu marketing save sits at the edge of the AI theme: production also needs discovery and conversion. It remains a short reading note. Timing, account strategy and traffic outcomes are the author’s experience, not guaranteed platform rules.

title.zh: “封杀 AI”标题下，实际是政府术语变更

description.zh: 核对行政命令原文后，变化是行政部门在适用的官方表述中使用 SI 代替 AI；既有历史文件无需全部修改。该命令本身并没有宣布禁用 AI 技术。涉及政策新闻时，先分清名称、法律定义与实质措施，才能判断实际影响。
description.en: The executive order concerns using SI instead of AI in applicable executive-branch communications; existing historical documents need not all be revised. The order does not itself ban the technology. Separate terminology, legal definitions and substantive measures before assessing impact.
